title: Gilbert–Varshamov bound for linear codes
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite field with $q = \abs{\alpha}$ elements, and let $n, k, d$ be natural numbers. Write $B_{d-1}(\mathbf{0})$ for the Hamming ball of radius $d-1$ about the all-zero codeword in $\alpha^n$, and suppose
\[
k \le n - \bigl\lceil \log_q \abs{B_{d-1}(\mathbf{0})} \bigr\rceil - 1.
\]
Then there exists an $n \times k$ generator matrix $G$ over $\alpha$ such that for every nonzero message $x \in \alpha^k$, the codeword $Gx \in \alpha^n$ has Hamming weight at least $d$.
hypotheses_covered: α is a finite field with q = |α| elements
n, k, d are natural numbers
k ≤ n − ⌈log_q |B_{d-1}(0)|⌉ − 1 (ceiling log base q of the Hamming ball of radius d−1 about zero)
conclusion: existence of an n×k generator matrix G mapping every nonzero message to a codeword of weight ≥ d
